description.description: Named volume torquedesk_db preserves Postgres data across container rebuilds.
Bound to 127.0.0.1:8081 to match pre-Docker nginx upstream; mounts torquedesk_data at /data.
Holds uploads, weekly ZIP backups, anything written under /data.
Zero-data-loss migration from bare-metal systemd to Docker Compose.
Rebranded TorqueDesk -> Fixora; applies theme pre-paint from localStorage torque-app.
Nightly DB dump + uploads + on-box backups to Drive with 30-day retention.
32x32 rounded-square SVG favicon with black background; white 'T' and orange 'F' letters forming the Fixora/TorqueDesk brand monogram.
